import pandas as pd

sheets = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name=None)
grand_total = 0.0
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} ===")
    print("Shape:", df.shape)
    print("Columns:", list(df.columns))
    print(df.head(10).to_string())
    num_cols = [c for c in df.columns if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[c])]
    print("Numeric columns:", num_cols)
    for c in num_cols:
        s = df[c].sum()
        print(f"Sum of '{c}': {s}")
        grand_total += s
    cat_col = next((c for c in df.columns if 'categor' in str(c).lower()), None)
    if cat_col and num_cols:
        amt_col = num_cols[0]
        print(f"Totals by {cat_col}:")
        print(df.groupby(cat_col)[amt_col].sum().to_string())
print("GRAND TOTAL (all numeric columns, all sheets):", grand_total)
